output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Everyone on build 7.4.0 crashes about 2% of sessions, versus about 0.7% on 7.3.2. That was already true on 2–3 Sep, before the flag ramp started. Only 7.4.0 users can get the flag, so the flag group is simply the 7.4.0 group. Within 7.4.0, flag-on is 2.10% and the random flag-off holdout is 1.98%. That 0.12-point difference is within noise. The leading crash cluster (41%) is a native crash in the upgraded image library, Pixelda, and it contains no canvas code. Device mix and usage are matched across the groups. The crash-reporting SDK change is not a counting artifact, because the app store's own figures agree. The 9 Sep sync-service deployment does not show up in the 7.3.2 rates. I'm fairly sure of this. A small flag effect of a few tenths of a point can't yet be ruled out. Don't turn the flag off and release 7.4.0 to 100%, because that would ship the real problem to everyone. Hold 7.4.0 at 25%. Prioritise a fix for the Pixelda crash. Keep the existing holdout running (or widen it) to settle the flag question. Don't roll back the SDK.
